purpose: Validate the required-field subset of an EMIR Refit ISO 20022 auth.030 derivative trade report: action type, both counterparty LEIs (20-char ISO 17442), UTI, UPI, notional, currency, effective date, and asset class. Catches missing or malformed fields before submission to the Trade Repository. Feeds UTI completeness checker (art-154).
